FormField.purpose: A complete form field composing a label, input, and helper text into one reusable unit.
types: InputGroup - text input with attached action button
structure_top_to_bottom: 1. <LabelRow> - label + optional required indicator + optional info icon
token_references: Spacing LabelRow -> Input: var(--space-2) (via LabelRow padding-bottom)
Spacing Input -> HelperRow: var(--space-1) (via HelperRow padding-top)
All further token references: see LabelRow, Input, HelperRow descriptions
agent_instructions: Always compose existing <LabelRow>, <Input>, <HelperRow> - never re-implement their markup
The helperState prop controls which HelperRow state is shown
Accept: type, size, label, required, showInfoIcon, helperState, helperMessage, and all Input props

LabelRow_State=Default.purpose: A label row displayed above every input field. Part of every FormField.
LabelRow_State=Default.structure: A <div> with display: flex, flex-direction: row, align-items: center, gap: var(--space-2), padding-bottom: var(--space-2).
agent_instructions: Always sits directly above an Input component

Input.purpose: A text input field for user data entry. Available standalone or with an attached action button.

agent_instructions: Never hardcode height - always use size tokens

Success - circle-check icon + text: color var(--color-success)
Error - triangle-exclamation icon + text: color var(--color-error)
